# go-modern-slices-compact

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use slices.Compact to remove consecutive duplicates in place.

## Details

slices.Compact removes consecutive duplicate values in place.
If the goal is to remove all duplicates, sort or otherwise group equal values first.

## Examples

### Before

```go
out := values[:0]
for i, value := range values {
  if i == 0 || value != values[i-1] {
    out = append(out, value)
  }
}
values = out
```

### After

```go
values = slices.Compact(values)
```
